headline: Q2FY27: Strong Presales with Healthy Pipeline

highlights: Result Update 9th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,950 Prestige Estates Projects Ltd Real Estate vv 1 Q2FY27: Strong Presales with Healthy Pipeline Recommendation Rationale • Launch Pipeline Strength: Prestige Estates remains well-positioned for another strong growth year, backed by a massive upcoming launch pipeline with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs 46,584 Cr.

Management noted that the primary hurdle for launches is securing RERA approvals rather than demand weakness, stating that as soon as approvals are secured, it anticipates healthy absorption. • Cash flow momentum and collections: The company generated robust operating cash flows of Rs 2,679 Cr in Q2FY27 and Rs 4,168 Cr for H1FY27.
Moving forward, management guided for total gross collections in the range of Rs 24,000 to Rs 25,000 Cr for the full year, which are expected to support free operating cash flows of ~Rs 9,000 Cr.

As a result, this liquidity provides a strong foundation for the company's aggressive growth, ensuring balance sheet stability while funding ongoing pipeline execution without heavily stretching its capital structure. • Commercial, Retail, and Hospitality Portfolio Expansion: Prestige continues to strengthen its long-term annuity and earnings profile through disciplined expansion across segments.
valuation: Result Update 9th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,950 Prestige Estates Projects Ltd Real Estate vv 1 Q2FY27: Strong Presales with Healthy Pipeline Recommendation Rationale • Launch Pipeline Strength: Prestige Estates remains well-positioned for another strong growth year, backed by a massive upcoming launch pipeline with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs 46,584 Cr.

Current Valuation: DCF-based Valuation Current TP: Rs 1,950/share (Earlier TP: Rs 1,830/share) Valuation & Recommendation: We raise our estimates for presales in this quarter to Rs 40,000 Cr from Rs 36,000 Cr and maintain our BUY recommendation on the stock.
We continue to value the company using a DCF-based valuation to arrive at a new TP of Rs 1,950/share, implying a 21% upside from the CMP.
watch: Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Management expressed confidence that demand will sustain for the next two to three years, with the mid-to-high segment always finding buyers regardless of the cycle.
